fields.label: Static definition description
fields.applicability_rule: Applicable as a definition field; may be known-empty or unknown.
fields.note: Also appended by Look only near the item; retain exact text and source version.

fields.label: Generated Look text
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: An assembled result, not stored BasicDescription. Requires known nonempty name and qualified item.

fields.label: Look header/name/count
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: No article/plural fields inferred. Stack count only when known stackable andcount>1.

fields.label: Look Atk/Def/Arm/Vol
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: Only explicitly handled known nonzero values are emitted; this formatter does not consume every Basic stat.

fields.label: Look equipment/use requirements
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: Equipment patterns must agree; unknown requirements are not invented.

fields.label: Near-only weight and description
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: Weight/description appended atdistance<=1; stack weight uses actual count.

fields.label: Look definition maxima/full duration
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: Maximum charges/full duration are definition facts, not remaining instance state.

fields.label: Look written-instance text
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: World-object reading has distinct distance/range/raw-ID branches; carried Look lacks this instance-text input.

fields.label: Article/plural grammar
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: Schema/formatter does not infer these; not established15.33 parity.

fields.label: Remaining charges/tier/imbuements/decay inside Look
fields.applicability_rule: Conditional generated component; compare using a future actual Look capture.
fields.note: This formatter explicitly does not invent timed/occupied instance state; separate inspection metadata route exists.

fields.label: Instance stack count
fields.applicability_rule: Any concrete instance; no type view count inference.
fields.note: Inspection hascount;Look uses it only for known stacks.

fields.label: Instance Forge tier
fields.applicability_rule: Only Forge-capable items; absence of forge record can be unresolved, nottier0.
fields.note: InspectionItem(handle) uses metadata;Catalogue(type) metadata=None is different.

fields.label: Occupied imbuement slots and remaining time
fields.applicability_rule: Only known slots>0 or explicitly eligible item.
fields.note: Empty occupied slot and absent source facts must remain distinct.

fields.label: Remaining instance charges
fields.applicability_rule: Only charges-capable item; explicit sourceNA isNA.
fields.note: Inspection currently formatscurrent/current;do not interpret as proven separate maximum.

fields.label: Remaining lifetime/expiry
fields.applicability_rule: Only temporal/decay-capable item; explicitNA isNA.
fields.note: Type full duration is notremaining instance duration.

fields.label: Container contents/total weight
fields.applicability_rule: Container or actual stack; otherwise context-dependent.
fields.note: Total contents weight differs from one type weight.

fields.label: Written instance text
fields.applicability_rule: Only eligible written/readable object.
fields.note: Not a static description and not part of Basic type evidence.

fields.label: Canonical identity/revision
fields.applicability_rule: All records, with explicitnamespace/binding qualification.
fields.note: Canonical key does not itself prove materialization or active generation.

fields.label: Legacy aliases
fields.applicability_rule: All records, with explicitnamespace/binding qualification.
fields.note: An alias is not a visible display name.

fields.label: External source ID/namespace
fields.applicability_rule: All records, with explicitnamespace/binding qualification.
fields.note: ots/item_server_id, mediawiki/page_id andappearance_id are distinct namespaces.

fields.label: Session native definition_ref
fields.applicability_rule: All records, with explicitnamespace/binding qualification.
fields.note: A transient/native index is not the Tibia numeric ID.

fields.label: Gold price/direction/count
fields.applicability_rule: Only offers relevant to the particular item; lack of offer is notzero price.
fields.note: BuyFromPlayer=NPC buys;SellToPlayer=player buys.

fields.label: Held source facts/conditions
fields.applicability_rule: Only offers relevant to the particular item; lack of offer is notzero price.
fields.note: Retained facts are not executable offers.

fields.label: Token/barter offers and currency
fields.applicability_rule: Only offers relevant to the particular item; lack of offer is notzero price.
fields.note: Do not compare100Silver Token to100gp.

fields.label: NPC residence/location
fields.applicability_rule: Only offers relevant to the particular item; lack of offer is notzero price.
fields.note: Residence is a separate fact and may vary byNPC variant.

fields.label: Appearance numeric identity
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: Source mapping exists;not ID observed in capturedUI.

fields.label: Admitted appearance membership
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: Membership/identity hash does not prove sprite pixels.

fields.label: Spritesheet/catalogue binding and digest
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: Specific frame-to-sheet asset binding not yet compared with15.33.

fields.label: Frame layout/layers/patterns
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: Frame count differs from unique animation phases.

fields.label: Animation phases/timing/loop
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: A3-second preview is not proof of a complete cycle.

fields.label: Transparency/alpha channel
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: No per-item asset alpha comparison done.

fields.label: Scale/placement/cropping
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: Native lossless screenshot quality does not establish identical renderer scaling.

fields.label: Pixel-level icon/animation equivalence
fields.applicability_rule: When an item has a visual representation; all per-item asset comparisons deferred.
fields.note: Deferred until basic fields; no image similarity claim frommatching IDs.

fields.label: Richer Basic stats not emitted bythisformatter
fields.applicability_rule: Only sourceformatter limitation;type fields may beNA
fields.note: Do not assume inspection stats automatically appear in generatedLook.
